input_contract.description: No input. The Orb reads the live machine read-only; the Orchestrator invokes it once at the scan phase.

output_contract.description: The $diag dictionary - 25 read-only collector sections - then validated into a SystemAudit before anything downstream may use it.
output_contract.diagnostics: object (25 top-level sections; each an observed reading)
output_contract.audit: SystemAudit { IsValid: bool, EvidenceHash: string } - only IsValid==true may reach the model/plan/consent/repair

observation_contract.description: The grounding referent for the whole run. The repair-plan Orb authors ONLY over these observations; the Communications & Governance Orb grounds the Custodian ONLY on the findings derived from them (via the relay). Nothing downstream may assert a machine fact this Orb did not observe.

evidence_contract.description: The SystemAudit EvidenceHash is the after-the-fact proof that a specific completed scan grounded this run; it binds the Technician->Communications findings relay record (StoreApp/FindingsRelayIntegration.cs, TOTEM-C-0112).

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: An incomplete or failed scan yields SystemAudit.IsValid==false and is declined at the audit gate with no model invocation - never a partial scan presented as complete.
